add_absolutism.doc: Adds absolutism to the current scope. Can also subtract. No effect if Absolutism isn't active.

add_accepted_culture.doc: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt.
add_accepted_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

add_accepted_culture_or_dip_power.doc: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope. In contrast to the standalone effect, this variant requires the culture to be specified by name. The dip reward will only be granted if the country has zero remaining promoted culture slots.

add_active_policy.doc: Adds a policy for the current scope. Policies are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/policies/*.txt. Won't work if the policy triggers are not met by the country, or there are no free policy slots.

add_adm_power.doc: Adds Administrative power to the current scope.

add_adm_tech.doc: Adds ADM technologies to the current scope. You cannot remove technologies.

add_aggressive_expansion.doc: Adds or Subtracts X amount of aggressive expansion opinion modifier of the scoped country against the country in WHO

add_army_professionalism.doc: Adds Army Professionalism to the current scope. 1 is equal to 100 professionalism.

add_army_tradition.doc: Adds Army Tradition to the current scope.

add_authority.doc: Adds authority to the current scope. Used in Religious Reforms that use authority. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using authority.

add_base_manpower.doc: Adds base manpower to the current province scope.

add_base_production.doc: Adds base production to the current province scope.

add_base_tax.doc: Adds base tax to the current province scope.

add_building.doc: Adds the defined building to the current province scope. Buildings are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt.

add_building_construction.doc: Starts building construction in the current province scope.

add_cardinal.doc: Adds a Cardinal to the current province scope, for the current owner.

add_casus_belli.doc: Adds a casus belli for the current scope against the defined scope. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt

add_center_of_trade_level.doc: Adds the specified amount to the province's center of trade levels. Cannot, however, make a province that is not a center of trade into one (use center_of_trade = 1)  Negative numbers also work to remove levels.

add_church_aspect.doc: Adds the defined aspect to the current scope. Church Aspects are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/church_aspects/00_church_aspects.txt. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_church_power and the aspect set in aspects. Does not work with Blessings.

add_church_power.doc: Adds Church Power to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_church_power.

add_claim.doc: In province scope, the defined scope gains a claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a claim on the defined province scope.
In province scope, the defined scope gains a claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a claim on the defined province scope.

add_colonysize.doc: Adds settlers to the current province scope of a colony.

add_company_manpower.doc: Adds or subtracts X% of the mercenary company's manpower.

add_construction_progress.doc: Changes the construction progress of any construction in the current province scope.

add_core.doc: In province scope, the defined scope gains a core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a core on the defined province scope.
In province scope, the defined scope gains a core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a core on the defined province scope.

add_core_construction.doc: Starts core construction in the current province scope, for the current owner.
Starts core construction in the current province scope, for the current owner.

add_corruption.doc: Adds corruption to the current scope. Can also subtract.

add_country_modifier.doc: Adds modifier to the current scope as a country modifier.

add_culture_construction.doc: Starts culture conversion in the current province scope, for the current owner.

add_curia_treasury.doc: Adds the specified amount of ducats to the Curia Treasury

add_devastation.doc: Adds devastation to the current province scope.

add_development_from_building.doc: Used only in the Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt file.

add_development_from_upgrading_or_buildi.doc: Used only in the Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt file.

add_devotion.doc: Adds devotion to the current scope. No effect if not a government using has_devotion.

add_dip_power.doc: Adds Diplomatic power to the current scope.

add_dip_tech.doc: Adds DIP technologies to the current scope. You cannot remove technologies.

add_disaster_modifier.doc: Applies an event modifier to the current scope that is removed when the disaster is over, or the duration runs out. Disasters are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/disasters/*.txt

add_disaster_progress.doc: Adds progress towards an already declared (conditions for disaster are met since at least a month) disaster

add_doom.doc: Adds doom to the current scope. Used in Religious Reforms that use doom. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using doom.

add_estate_influence_modifier.doc: Adds an influence modifier for the defined estate used by the current scope. Estates are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/estates/*.txt

add_estate_loyalty.doc: Adds loyalty for the defined estate used by the current scope. Estates are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/estates/*.txt

add_estate_loyalty_modifier.doc: Adds a loyalty modifier for the defined estate used by the current scope. Estates are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/estates/*.txt

add_faction.doc: Adds a faction to the current scope. Factions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/factions/.

add_faction_influence.doc: Adds influence for the defined faction. Mimics the influence boost from pressing the button in the faction window.

add_favors.doc: Adds favors with the defined scope for the current scope.

add_fervor.doc: Adds Fervor to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using fervor.

add_garrison.doc: Adds the given number of men to the province garrison.

add_government_power.doc: Changes the pool size of one of the power pools within a government mechanic.

add_government_power_scaled_to_seats.doc: Changes the pool size of one of the power pools within a government mechanic, scaled to number of seats in parliament.

add_government_reform.doc: If Dharma is active, enacts a government reform, replacing any existing reform at the same tier. If Dharma is not active, changes to the legacy government type that this reform has listed as its legacy_equivalent.

add_great_project.doc: Starts construction of a great project in the current province scope. Great projects are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/great_projects/*.txt.

add_harmonization_progress.doc: Adds Harmonization Progress for the current harmonization target to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

add_harmonized_religion.doc: Adds a religion to the list of Harmonized religions for the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

add_harmony.doc: Adds Harmony to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_harmony.

add_heir_claim.doc: Adds to the current scope's heir claim.

add_heir_personality.doc: Adds the defined personality to the current heir. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

add_heir_support.doc: Adds to the local heir's support in an Elective Monarchy.

add_historical_friend.doc: Makes the defined scope a historical friend of the current scope.

add_historical_rival.doc: Makes the defined scope a historical rival of the current scope.

add_horde_unity.doc: Adds horde unity to the current scope. No effect if not a government using nomad.

add_idea.doc: Adds an idea for the current scope. Ideas are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ideas/*.txt. Won't work if the idea isn't present in a National Idea set or a taken Idea groups set for the country

add_idea_group.doc: Adds an idea group for the current scope. Idea groups are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ideas/*.txt. Won't work if the country doesn't have any free idea group slots.

add_imperial_influence.doc: Adds Imperial Influence for the current scope. No effect if not emperor.

add_incident_variable_value.doc: Changes the value of an Incident for the current scope. Incidents are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/isolationism/*.txt

add_inflation.doc: Adds inflation to the current scope. Can also subtract.

add_institution_embracement.doc: Adds institution embracement progress for the defined institution in the current province scope. The defined institution must be enabled for the owner of the province first.

add_isolationism.doc: Adds Isolationism to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

add_karma.doc: Adds Karma to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_karma.

add_latent_trade_goods.doc: Adds a latent trade good to the province.

add_legitimacy.doc: Adds legitimacy to the current scope. Can also subtract. Target can be a country, in which case that country's legitimacy value is used. No effect if not a government monarchy.

add_liberty_desire.doc: Adds liberty desire to the current scope.

add_loan.doc: Adds a loan to a country. interest_modifier: Adds or subtracts a value from the base interest value. fixed_interest: Interest will be the specified value. duration: Sets the amount of months before the loan is due. estate_loan = yes: Means that if a country has this loan, has_estate_loan will return true.

add_local_autonomy.doc: Adds local autonomy to the current province scope.

add_mandate.doc: Adds mandate to the current scope. No effect if not the Emperor of China.

add_manpower.doc: Adds manpower to the current scope. 1 is equal to 1000 manpower.

add_mercantilism.doc: Adds mercantilism to the current scope. Can also subtract.

add_meritocracy.doc: Adds meritocracy to the current scope. No effect if not a government using has_meritocracy.

add_mil_power.doc: Adds Military power to the current scope.

add_mil_tech.doc: Adds MIL technologies to the current scope. You cannot remove technologies.

add_militarised_society.doc: Adds militarization of society to the current scope. Can also subtract. No effect if the government does not use the Prussian monarchy militarization mechanic.

add_named_unrest.doc: Adds unrest to a province with a specified name

add_nationalism.doc: Adds Nationalism to the current province scope.

add_navy_tradition.doc: Adds Navy Tradition to the current scope.

add_next_institution_embracement.doc: Adds embracement for the current progressing institution within the current scope. Institutions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/institutions/*.txt.

add_next_institution_embracement_scaled.doc: Adds embracement of an institution based on the development of the province, up to 10% embracement.

add_opinion.doc: Adds an opinion modifier for the current scope held against the defined scope. Opinion modifiers are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt

add_owned_provinces_development_ducats.doc: Add ducats based on the development of owned provinces, multiplier, age_multiplier, custom_tooltip, and trigger control behaviour, check the individual keys

add_owned_provinces_development_manpower.doc: Add manpower based on the development of owned provinces, multiplier, age_multiplier, custom_tooltip, and trigger control behaviour, check the individual keys

add_papal_influence.doc: Adds Papal Influence to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using papacy.

add_patriarch_authority.doc: Adds Patriarch Authority to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using has_patriarchs.

add_permanent_claim.doc: In province scope, the defined scope gains a permanent claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a permanent claim on the defined province scope.
In province scope, the defined scope gains a permanent claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a permanent claim on the defined province scope.

add_permanent_province_modifier.doc: Adds an event modifier to the current province scope as a province modifier. Modifiers added with this effect persist through ownership changes.

add_piety.doc: Adds Piety to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_piety

add_power_projection.doc: Adds a certain amount of power projection to the country

add_prestige.doc: Adds prestige to the current scope. Can also subtract.

add_prosperity.doc: Adds prosperity to the current province scope.

add_province_modifier.doc: Adds an event modifier to the current province scope as a province modifier. Modifiers added with this effect are cleared automatically when the province changes ownership.

add_province_triggered_modifier.doc: Adds a province triggered modifier to the current province scope.

add_queen_personality.doc: Adds the defined personality to the current consort. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

add_random_development.doc: Add X random development to the scoped province

add_rebel_progress.doc: Adds X rebel progress of type Y, if type is not defined then all rebels get it

add_reform_center.doc: Adds a Center of Reformation for the defined religion in the current province scope.

add_reform_desire.doc: Adds or subtracts Catholic Reform Desire.

add_reform_desire_scale.doc: Adds or subtracts Catholic Reform Desire.

add_republican_tradition.doc: Adds republican tradition to the current scope. No effect if not a government using republic.

add_revolutionary_zeal.doc: Adds X revolutionary zeal to the country

add_rival.doc: Makes the defined scope a rival of the current scope.

add_ruler_modifier.doc: Adds an event modifier to the current scope as a ruler modifier. Ruler modifiers are cleared when the ruler dies.

add_ruler_personality.doc: Adds the defined personality to the current ruler. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

add_sailors.doc: Adds sailors to the current scope. 100 is equal to 100 sailors but 0-1 is read as a fraction of the total sailor cap of the country.

add_scaled_imperial_influence.doc: Adds Imperial Influence for the current scope, scaled by the current Imperial Authority value. No effect if not emperor.

add_scaled_local_adm_power.doc: Adds Administrative power to the owner of the current province scope, scaling with the base tax. 1 power per point of yearly base tax.

add_scaled_local_dip_power.doc: Adds Diplomatic power to the owner of the current province scope, scaling with the base production. 1 power per point of yearly base tax.

add_scaled_local_mil_power.doc: Adds Military power to the owner of the current province scope, scaling with the base manpower. 1 power per point of yearly base tax.

add_scaled_republican_tradition.doc: Adds republican tradition to the current scope. Scales to the government's election cycle duration. No effect if not a government using republic.

add_siberian_construction.doc: Adds to the Native Ferocity within an uncolonized provinceStarts a siberian colony in the current province scope. Only works if the ROOT scope is a country that can use Siberian Frontiers.

add_splendor.doc: Adds splendor to the current scope. Splendor is used to purchase Age abilities. Can also subtract.

add_spy_network_from.doc: Adds spy network in the current scope for the defined scope.

add_spy_network_in.doc: Adds spy network for the current scope in the defined scope.

add_stability.doc: Adds stability to the current scope.

add_subjects_development_ducats.doc: Add ducats based on the development of subjects, multiplier, age_multiplier, custom_tooltip, and trigger control behaviour, check the individual keys

add_subjects_development_manpower.doc: Add manpower based on the development of subjects, multiplier, age_multiplier, custom_tooltip, and trigger control behaviour, check the individual keys

add_tariff_value.doc: Adds tariff value to to the current scope. Tariff value is the ducats sent to an overlord by subjects such as colonial nations. Can also subtract.

add_territorial_core.doc: In province scope, the defined scope gains a territorial core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a territorial core on the defined province scope.
In province scope, the defined scope gains a territorial core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope gains a territorial core on the defined province scope.

add_to_trade_company.doc: Adds province to scopes trade company. Will remove state first if it exists.

add_trade_company_investment.doc: Adds a trade company investment in the provinces area. Investment keys are found in common/tradecompany_investments.

add_trade_modifier.doc: Adds a trade modifier for the defined country scope in the current tradenode province scope. Can be added to any province within a tradenode.

add_trade_node_income.doc: Adds income to the current tradenode province scope. Only works when the current province scope is the location of a tradenode center.

add_treasury.doc: Adds ducats to the current scope. Can also subtract.

add_truce_with.doc: Creates a truce between the defined scope and the current scope. The truce length is the default white peace truce length.

add_trust.doc: Adds trust with the defined scope for the current scope. Used in conjuction with the Diplomatic Feedback mechanic from The Cossacks DLC.

add_unit_construction.doc: Builds the defined units as a percentage of the owner's forcelimit in the current province scope. 1 is equal to 100% of the owner's forcelimit.

add_unrest.doc: Adds Local Unrest to the current province scope. Appears under Base Unrest.

add_war_exhaustion.doc: Adds war exhaustion to the current scope.

add_yearly_manpower.doc: Adds manpower to the current scope, as a percentage of total yearly manpower. 1 is equal to 100% of total yearly manpower.

add_yearly_sailors.doc: Adds sailors to the current scope, as a percentage of total yearly sailors. 1 is equal to 100% of total yearly sailors.

add_years_of_estate_land_income.doc: Adds yearly income x (1 - crown land share) x years

add_years_of_income.doc: Adds ducats equal to the years of income defined. 1 is equal to 1 year of income, based of a country's current monthly income.

add_years_of_owned_provinces_manpower.doc: Gives you a lump of manpower equivalent to X years of manpower by Y provinces (based on how much they currently produce).

add_years_of_owned_provinces_production_.doc: Gives you a lump sum equivalent to x years of production income by y provinces (based on how much they currently produce).

add_years_of_owned_provinces_sailors.doc: Gives you a lump of manpower equivalent to X years of sailors by Y provinces (based on how much they currently produce).

adm_power_cost.doc: Multiplies the value by all_power_cost modifiers

adopt_reform_progress.doc: Adopts the government reform progress from the target country scope. Used when the Papal States is released.

apply_sprite_pack.doc: Applies a specified sprite pack (found in gfx/sprite_packs, often in DLC files) to the country. Not great verifying in DLC files for mods.

area.doc: Refers to the area that the current province scope is in.

artillery.doc: Spawns an artillery unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected artillery unit.
Spawns an artillery unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected artillery unit.

back_current_issue.doc: Backs or blocks the current issue in Parliament, if the current province scope has a seat. No effect if the owner of the province does not have a government using has_parliament.

banner_cavalry.doc: Creates a Banner Cavalry in the scoped province, for the defined scope

banner_infantry.doc: Creates a Banner Infantry in the scoped province, for the defined scope

break_alliance.doc: Force scoped country to break the alliance with specified country

break_marriage.doc: Breaks the current scope's royal marriage with the defined scope.

break_union.doc: Breaks the current scope's union with the defined scope.

build_to_forcelimit.doc: Builds the defined units as a percentage of the owner's forcelimit in the current province scope. 1 is equal to 100% of the owner's forcelimit.

cancel_construction.doc: Cancels any construction ongoing in the current province scope. Constructions are coring, religious conversion, cultural conversion, buildings and great projects.

cancel_current_debate.doc: Cancels current debate, allowing a new debate to start

caravel_light.doc: Spawns a caravel light ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current light ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

carolean_infantry.doc: Spawns a carolean infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

cavalry.doc: Spawns a cavalry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.
Spawns a cavalry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

cawa_infantry.doc: Spawns a cawa infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

cede_province.doc: The defined scope gains ownership of the current province scope. previous_owner can be used to cede ownership to the last previous owner of a province.

center_of_trade.doc: Makes the province a center of trade of the specified level.

change_adm.doc: Adds ADM skill to the current ruler.

change_consort_regent_to_ruler.doc: Makes a consort regent into the current ruler for the current scope.

change_controller.doc: The defined scope gains control over the current province scope. Control here means occupation, not ownership.

change_country_color.doc:
Changes country color to country in scope or a RGB defined color, or yes to restore it
Changes country color to country in scope or a RGB defined color, or yes to restore it

change_culture.doc: Changes the culture of the current province scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
change_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | enum<country_tags> | scope<country> | ref<province_id> | scope<province>

change_dip.doc: Adds DIP skill to the current ruler.

change_estate_land_share.doc: Adds or removes X amount of land from the Estate's base land share.

change_government.doc: Changes the government of the current scope. Governments are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/governments/*.txt. In rebel_types, REB will make it pick the preferred rebel government.

change_government_reform_progress.doc: Adds reform progress to the current scope.

change_graphical_culture.doc: Changes the current scope's graphical culture. Graphical culture determines the unit models, advisor portraits, etc that a country uses. Graphical cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/graphicalculturetype.txt.

change_heir_adm.doc: Adds ADM skill to the current heir.

change_heir_dip.doc: Adds DIP skill to the current heir.

change_heir_mil.doc: Adds MIL skill to the current heir.

change_innovativeness.doc: Adds innovativeness to the current scope. Range [-100.0, 100.0] capped to [0.0, 100.0].

change_mil.doc: Adds MIL skill to the current ruler.

change_national_focus.doc: Changes the National Focus, or none to disable it

change_native_ferocity.doc: Adds to the Native Ferocity within an uncolonized province.

change_native_hostileness.doc: Adds to the Native Hostileness within an uncolonized province.

change_native_size.doc: Adds to the amount of natives within an uncolonized province.

change_original_culture.doc: Changes the original culture of the current province scope. Unlike the current culture, this one is the one defined in the province history and is always available to convert back to.
change_original_culture.value: 'FROM' | ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | enum<country_tags> | scope<country> | ref<province_id> | scope<province>

change_personal_deity.doc: Changes the current personal deity for the current scope. Personal Deities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/personal_deities/*.txt. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using personal_deity.

change_price.doc: Changes the price of a trade good globally. Tradegood prices are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/prices/*.txt. The new price is the base price + (base price * value). Duration accepts -1 for unlimited duration.

change_primary_culture.doc: Changes the primary culture of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt.
change_primary_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

change_province_name.doc: Changes the province name of the current province scope to the defined name.

change_religion.doc: Changes the religion of the current country/province scope. Religions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/religions/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
Changes the religion of the current country/province scope. Religions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/religions/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.

change_siege.doc: Changes the siege progress in the current province scope.

change_statists_vs_monarchists.doc: Changes the Organist-Monarchist balance. Positive (probably) moves towards Monarchist, negative (probably) moves towards Statists.

change_statists_vs_orangists.doc: Changes the Organist-Statist balance. Positive moves towards Orangist, negative moves towards Statists.

change_technology_group.doc: Changes the technology group of the current scope. Technology Groups are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/technology.txt.. Doesn't change units, use change_unit_type.

change_to_secondary_religion.doc: Changes the religion in the current province scope to the syncretic religion of its owner.

change_trade_goods.doc: Sets the trade good for the current province scope. Trade Goods are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/tradegoods/*.txt.

change_unit_type.doc: Change the unit type for the current scope. The unit types correspond to the technology groups found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/technology.txt. 1.1

change_variable.doc: Paradox reports that which = is optional

clear_exiled_ruler.doc: Clears a saved exiled ruler. Can use this after using the saved exiled ruler in an effect.

clear_global_event_target.doc: Clears a specific global event target.

clear_rebels.doc: Remove all rebels in target province(s).

clear_saved_name.doc: Clears a saved name key. Use this after using the saved name in an effect.

clr_consort_flag.doc: Clears a ruler flag for the current scope's consort.

clr_country_flag.doc: Clears a defined country flag for the current scope.

clr_heir_flag.doc: Clears an heir flag for the current scope's heir.

clr_province_flag.doc: Clears a defined province flag for the current province scope.

clr_ruler_flag.doc: Clears a ruler flag for the current scope's ruler.

collapse_nation.doc: Causes owned cores of the current scope to be released as nations and for them to take a percentage of the current scope's owned provinces.

complete_mission.doc: Marks a mission as completed. Mission rewards are not given when using this effect. It will count towards any missions that require it, and it will count as completed in the mission_completed trigger.

convert_female_heir_to_general.doc: Converts a female heir into a general.

convert_female_ruler_to_general.doc: Converts a female ruler into a general.

convert_heir_to_general.doc: Converts a male heir into a general.

convert_ruler_to_admiral.doc: Converts a male ruler into a admiral, a number can be provided instead of 'yes' to use as tradition during generation.

convert_ruler_to_general.doc: Converts a male ruler into a general, a number can be provided instead of 'yes' to use as tradition during generation.

cossack_cavalry.doc: Spawns a cossack cavalry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

cossack_infantry.doc: Spawns a cossack infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

country_event.doc: Fire a country event for the current country scope. You cannot fire the same event within itself.

create_admiral.doc: Generates an new admiral for the current scope. The number is the amount of navy tradition to use in generation.

create_advisor.doc: In country scope, adds the defined advisor to the current scope. Defaults the advisor's location to the capital, and religion and culture to the current scope's. In province scope, adds the defined advisor for the owner of the current province scope.

create_alliance.doc: Creates an alliance between the current scope and the defined scope.

create_colony.doc: Starts a colony belonging to the owner of the ROOT province scope. Use with e.g. random_empty_neighbor_province

create_conquistador.doc: Generates an new conquistador for the current scope. The number is the amount of army tradition to use in generation.

create_explorer.doc: Generates an new explorer for the current scope. The number is the amount of navy tradition to use in generation.

create_flagship.doc: Spawns a flagship unit for the current scope in the defined province scope. Types light_ship, galley, heavy_ship and transport. Requires the province scope to have a port.

create_general.doc: Generates an new general for the current scope.

create_guarantee.doc: Creates an guarantee over the defined scope for the current scope.

create_independent_estate.doc: Creates an independent nation from provinces owned by the specified estate within the current scope's owned provinces. Estates are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/estates/*.txt. The additional parameters for the independent nation are found within an estate's file.

create_independent_estate_from_religion.doc: Creates an independent nation from provinces owned by the specified estate within the current scope's owned provinces. Estates are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/estates/*.txt. Created with the religion that the majority of the provinces that the defined estate own holds. The additional parameters for the independent nation are found within an estate's file.

create_march.doc: Makes the defined scope a march subject of the current scope. Uses the march subject type.

create_marriage.doc: Creates a royal marriage between the current scope and the defined scope.

create_native.doc: Spawns natives in the current province scope. Only useful in colonies; will immediately disappear in cities or uncolonized provinces.

create_pirate.doc: Spawns pirates in the current province scope. Only spawnable in sea zones and land provinces with ports.

create_revolt.doc: Spawns the most likely rebel type in the current province scope.

create_subject.doc: Makes the defined scope into the defined subject type under the current scope. Subject types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/subject_types/*.txt.

create_union.doc: Makes the defined scope a junior partner in a personal union with the current scope.

create_unit_forcelimit_percentage.doc: Builds the defined units as a percentage of the owner's forcelimit in capital of the current country scope.

create_vassal.doc: Makes the defined scope a vassal subject of the current scope. Uses the vassal subject type.

custom_tooltip.doc: Displays a localized key in the effect tooltip.

declare_war.doc: Creates a no casus belli war against the defined scope for the current scope.

declare_war_with_cb.doc: Declares war for the current scope against the defined scope, using the defined casus belli. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt

decolonize.doc:
Decolonizes the scoped province, making it unowned
Decolonizes the specified province, making it unowned

define_admiral.doc: Creates an admiral with the defined attributes for the current scope. Leader traits can be found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/leader_personalities/*.txt. Siege improves Blockade Efficiency for admirals. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_advisor.doc: Adds the defined advisor to the current scope. Advisor types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/advisortypes/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values for the culture and religion parameters. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_conquistador.doc: Creates a conquistador with the defined attributes for the current scope. Leader traits can be found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/leader_personalities/*.txt. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_consort.doc: Creates the defined consort for the current scope. The skill values are not rolled for consorts, meaning the values set are the exact values a consort gets.

define_exiled_ruler.doc: Defines a new exiled ruler, saving them to the unique string. Works similarly to define_ruler and accepts the same arguments.

define_explorer.doc: Creates an explorer with the defined attributes for the current scope. Leader traits can be found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/leader_personalities/*.txt. Siege improves Blockade Efficiency for explorers. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_general.doc: Creates a general with the defined attributes for the current scope. Leader traits can be found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/leader_personalities/*.txt. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_heir.doc: Creates the defined heir for the current scope. The culture and religion attributes can utilise Event Scope Values. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

define_heir_to_general.doc: Creates a general from the heir of the current scope.

define_leader_to_ruler.doc: Creates a ruler from a leader for the current scope.

define_ruler.doc: Creates the defined ruler for the current scope. The culture and religion attributes can utilise Event Scope Values. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.  If dynasty = historic_dynasty is used the game will pick one weighted by how many rulers a family has had.

define_ruler_to_general.doc: Creates a general from the ruler for the current scope.

destroy_great_project.doc: Destroys a great project, setting it to tier 0

dip_power_cost.doc: Multiplies the value by all_power_cost modifiers

disables_hre_badboy_points.doc: Part of Imperial Reforms - not on wiki or patch notes

disband_all_regiments.doc: Disbands all regiments, even those in combat, considered "stack wiped"

disband_all_ships.doc: Disbands all ships, even those in combat, considered "stack wiped"

disband_all_units.doc: Disbands all units, even those in combat, considered "stack wiped"

disband_rebels.doc: Disbands all active rebels of the specified type in the provinces of the current scope. Rebel types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/rebel_types/*.txt

discover_country.doc: The defined scope gains vision over the current province scope. Best used within areas, regions, etc to add vision.

discover_province.doc: The current country scope gains vision over the defined province scope. Best used with areas, regions, etc to add vision.

dismantle_empire_of_china.doc: Removes the Empire of China and the Mandate system.

dismantle_hre.doc: Disbands the HRE and removes all members from it.

dissolve_parliament.doc: Disables the Parliament mechanic. Only affects governments with has_parliament.

elector.doc: Makes the current scope an elector (or no longer an elector) of the Holy Roman Empire.

else.doc: Follows if/else_if; executes when no previous branch ran.

else_if.doc: Follows an if or another else_if block; executes when its triggers are met and no previous branch ran.

embrace_institutions_of.doc: Changes the institutions of the current scope.

enable_imperial_realm_war.doc: Part of Imperial Reforms - not on wiki or patch notes

enable_religion.doc: Enables a religion that has been restricted with the date parameter. Religions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/religions/*.txt

enact_issue.doc: Enacts a parliament issue, skipping the debate

end_current_debate.doc: Ends current debate, if yes debate passes and is enacted, if no debate fails and you get penalized

end_disaster.doc: Immediately ends an active disaster for the current scope. Disasters are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/disasters/*.txt

every_ally.doc: Scopes to all valid countries that meet the triggers in the limit.

every_coalition_member.doc: Scopes to all members of the coalition against the current scope (if any).

every_core_country.doc: Scopes to all countries that have a core on the current scope, whether existing or not.

every_core_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces that this country has a core on, whether owned or not.

every_country.doc: Scopes to all countries in the world. Avoid this if you can use something more specific.

every_country_including_inactive.doc: Scopes to all countries in the world including inactive. Avoid this if you can use something more specific.

every_elector.doc: Scopes to all electors of the HRE.

every_empty_neighbor_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces sharing a border (or sea zone?) with the current scope that are colonizable and uncolonized.

every_enemy_country.doc: Scopes to all valid countries that meet the triggers in the limit.

every_heretic_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces whose religion is heretic to the current scope.

every_known_country.doc: Scopes to all countries that have been discovered by the current scope.

every_local_enemy.doc: Scopes to all valid countries that meet the triggers in the limit.

every_neighbor_country.doc: Scopes to all countries that share a border (or sea zone?) with the current scope.

every_neighbor_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces sharing a border (or sea zone?) with the current scope. Does not include empty provinces.

every_owned_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces the current scope owns.

every_privateering_country.doc: Scopes to all countries that are sending privateers to the current scope.

every_province.doc: Scopes to all provinces in the world. Note: executing effects on every province without a limit will cause slowdown in game. Use something more specific if you can.

every_province_in_state.doc: Scopes to all provinces in the same state (area?).

every_rival_country.doc: Scopes to all valid countries that meet the triggers in the limit.

every_subject_country.doc: Scopes to all subject nations under the current scope.

every_trade_node_member_country.doc: Scopes to all countries that own a province in the current scope.

every_trade_node_member_province.doc: Scopes to every province in the current trade node.

every_tribal_land_province.doc: Scopes to every tribal land province

excommunicate.doc: Excommunicates the defined scope. If already excommunicated, removes excommunication.

exile_consort_as.doc: Removes the current consort of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

exile_heir_as.doc: Removes the current heir of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

exile_ruler_as.doc: Removes the current ruler of the current scope, saving them to the unique string.

extend_country_modifier.doc: Extends current country modifier X by Y days

extend_golden_age.doc: Extends the current Golden Age by X months

extend_province_modifier.doc: Extends the duration of an existing province modifier held by the current province scope. Modifiers added with this effect persist through ownership changes.

force_converted.doc: Sets whether the current scope has been force converted.

force_create_marriage.doc: Creates a royal marriage between the current scope and the defined scope. Allows the creation of royal marriages between nations and religions disallowing it.

force_remove_rival.doc: Removes the defined scope as a rival of the current scope. That country cannot be picked as a rival again for the next 15 years.

form_coalition_against.doc: The current scope creates or joins a coalition against the defined scope.

free_vassal.doc: Frees a vassal from the current scope.

freeze_government_power.doc: Freezes the pool size of one of the power pools within a government mechanic so it cannot changed until unfrozen.

galleass_galley.doc: Spawns a galleass galley ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current galley ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

galleon_heavy.doc: Spawns a galleon heavy ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current heavy ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

galley.doc: Spawns a galley ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current galley ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.
Spawns a galley ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current galley ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.

generate_estate_agenda.doc: Generates an agenda for the specified estate, which can then be started with start_estate_agenda = <estate>

geobukseon_galley.doc: Spawns a geobukseon galley ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current galley ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

grant_independence.doc: The current scope is granted independence from their overlord.
The current scope is granted independence from their overlord.

heavy_ship.doc: Spawns a heavy ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current heavy ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.
Spawns a heavy ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current heavy ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.

hidden_effect.doc: Hides the enclosed effects from appearing as tooltips

hide_ambient_object.doc: Hides a visible ambient object from the map/ambient_objects.txt file.

hire_advisor.doc: Adds the defined advisor to the current scope. Advisor types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/advisortypes/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values for the culture and religion parameters. The name parameter can accept a saved name variable, see set_saved_name for more context.

holy_order.doc: Applies the specified holy order to the province

hre_inheritable.doc: Makes the seat of the Emperor inheritable or no longer inheritable.

hussars_cavalry.doc: Spawns a hussars cavalry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

if.doc: Executes the enclosed block only when the trigger conditions are met; enables if/else_if/else branching.

imperial_ban_allowed.doc: Enables or disables the Imperial Ban casus belli.

infantry.doc: Spawns a infantry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.
Spawns a infantry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

inherit.doc: The current scope inherits all of the defined scope's provinces.

internal_hre_cb.doc: Enables or disables casus belli creation for HRE members against one another.

janissary_infantry.doc: Spawns a janissary infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

join_all_defensive_wars_of.doc: Makes the current scope join all defensive wars of the specified scope.

join_all_offensive_wars_of.doc: Makes the current scope join all offensive wars of the specified scope

join_league.doc: Makes the current scope join the specified League.

kill_advisor.doc: Kills a hired advisor for the current scope. Advisor types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/advisortypes/*.txt. Displays the advisor death message box when used. Only works for advisors that have been hired.

kill_consort.doc: Kills the consort of the current scope. Displays consort death message.

kill_heir.doc: Kills the heir of the current scope. Displays heir death message.

kill_leader.doc: In country scope, kills a leader held by the current scope matching the type used. Format: kill_leader = { type = general/random/name }. In province scope, kills a leader in the current province scope if they match the type used. Format: kill_leader = general/random/name Only works if the leader is assigned to a unit that is stationed in the current province.
Scalar spelling accepted by kill_leader (e.g. kill_leader = general).

kill_mercenary_leader.doc: Kills the leader of the scoped mercenary company

kill_ruler.doc: Kills the ruler of the current scope.

kill_units.doc: Kills units following the defined parameters in the current province scope. In the who parameter, you can use enemy, owner and controller. When used with no parameters, will kill all units within the current province scope.

leave_league.doc: Makes the current scope leave the specified League.

light_ship.doc: Spawns a light ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current light ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.
Spawns a light ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current light ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.

limit.doc: Restricts a scope or iterator statement to targets matching the enclosed triggers.

loan_size.doc: Changes the loan size of the current scope. Default size is 6.

log.doc: Displays a string (specified here in "") in the game.log when executed. Accepts all localization commands (i.e. [Root.GetName], etc)

lose_reforms.doc: Removes government reforms from the current scope.

mamluks_cavalry.doc: Spawns a mamluks cavalry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

mamluks_infantry.doc: Spawns a mamluks infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

man_of_war_heavy.doc: Spawns a man of war heavy ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current heavy ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

man_of_war_light.doc: Spawns a man of war light ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current light ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

marine_infantry.doc: Spawns a marine infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

mercenary_cavalry.doc: Spawns a mercenary cavalry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected mercenary cavalry unit.
Spawns a mercenary cavalry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected mercenary cavalry unit.

mercenary_infantry.doc: Spawns a mercenary infantry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected mercenary infantry unit.
Spawns a mercenary infantry unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the currently selected mercenary infantry unit.

mil_power_cost.doc: Multiplies the value by all_power_cost modifiers

modulo_variable.doc: Sets a variable to the remainder of dividing it by `value` (or a second `which = <var>`).

move_great_project.doc: Moves the specified great project to the current province.

multiply_colonysize.doc: Multiplies the settler count in the current province scope of a colony.

musketeer_infantry.doc: Spawns a musketeer infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

native_policy.doc: Sets the native policy to the specified policy

override_country_name.doc: Changes the name of the country to another specified localisation key. Needs <key>_ADJ for the adjectives.

play_sound.doc: Plays a sound effect as defined in an .asset file in the sould/ folder

province_event.doc: Fire a province event for the current province scope. Appears for the owner of the province scope. You cannot fire the same event within itself.

province_group.doc: Refers to the province_group that the current province scope is in.

qizilbash_cavalry.doc: Spawns a qizilbash cavalry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

qizilbash_infantry.doc: Spawns a qizilbash infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

raise_war_taxes.doc: Raises war taxes without spending Military Power.

rajput_infantry.doc: Spawns a rajput infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

random.doc: The random scope is used to add a single random roll to a set of effects. The chance is out of 100.

random_active_trade_node.doc: Scopes to one valid tradenode (province) that meet the triggers in the limit. Active means the current scope is interacting with the trade node in some way.

random_ally.doc: Scopes to one valid country that meet the triggers in the limit.

random_area_province.doc: Scope to a random province in the area

random_capital_province.doc: Scope to a random capital province.

random_claimed_province.doc: Scope to a random claimed province.

random_coalition_member.doc: Scopes to one random member of the coalition against the current scope.

random_core_country.doc: Scopes to one random country that has a core on the current scope, whether existing or not.

random_core_province.doc: Scopes to one random province that the current scope has a core on, whether owned or not.

random_country.doc: Scopes to one random country among all countries in the world. Avoid this if you can use something more specific.

random_elector.doc: Scopes to one random elector of the HRE.

random_empty_neighbor_province.doc: Scopes to one random province sharing a border (or sea zone?) with the current scope that is colonizable and uncolonized.

random_enemy_country.doc: Scopes to one valid country that meet the triggers in the limit.

random_heretic_province.doc: Scopes to one random province whose religion is heretic to the current scope.

random_hired_mercenary_company.doc: Scopes to a random hired mercenary company. Optional parameters: template = <string>, is_foreign_company = yes, hired_for_months = <int>, has_company_manpower = <int>.

random_known_country.doc: Scopes to one random country that has been discovered by the current scope.

random_list.doc: The random_list scope is used to add different sets of effects to a single random roll.

random_local_enemy.doc: Scopes to one valid country that meet the triggers in the limit.

random_neighbor_country.doc: Scopes to one random country that shares a border (or sea zone?) with the current scope.

random_neighbor_province.doc: Scopes to one random province sharing a border(or sea zone?) with the current scope. Does not include empty provinces.

random_owned_area.doc: Scopes to one valid area that meet the triggers in the limit. You can use type = all to scope to all valid areas.

random_owned_province.doc: Scopes to one random province the current scope owns.

random_privateering_country.doc: Scopes to one random country that is sending privateers to the current scope.

random_province.doc: Scopes to one random province among all provinces in the world.

random_province_in_state.doc: Scopes to one random province in the same state as the current scope.

random_rival_country.doc: Scopes to one valid country that meet the triggers in the limit.

random_subject_country.doc: Scopes to one random subject country under the current scope.

random_trade_node.doc: Scopes to one random trade node.

random_trade_node_member_country.doc: Scopes to one random country that owns a province in the current scope.

random_trade_node_member_province.doc: Scopes to one random province in the current trade node.

random_variable.doc: Sets a variable to a random float between 0 and `value` (or a second `which = <var>`).

random_war_enemy_country.doc: Scope to a random war enemy country.

recall_merchant.doc: Recalls a placed merchant in the current tradenode province scope.  Only works when the current province scope is the location of a tradenode center.

regenerate_government_mechanics.doc: Regenerates the country's government mechanics. Used for UI purposes

region.doc: Refers to the region that the current province scope is in.

reinstate_parliament.doc: Re-enables the Parliament mechanic after dissolve_parliament. Only affects governments with has_parliament.

release.doc: The current scope releases all provinces with the defined scope's cores.

release_all_possible_countries.doc: Forces the scoped country to release all possible nations, starting from smallest to biggest if possible, otherwise randomly

release_all_subjects.doc: The current scope releases all possible subjects from cores.

remove_accepted_culture.doc: Removes an accepted culture from the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt.
remove_accepted_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

remove_advisor.doc: Removes a hired advisor for the current scope. Advisor types are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/advisortypes/*.txt. Does not display the advisor death message box when used. Only works for advisors that have been hired.

remove_advisor_by_category.doc: Removes a hired advisor of a monarch power type for the current scope. Fires on_action for advisor being fired.

remove_advisor_by_category_no_action.doc: Removes a hired advisor of a monarch power type for the current scope. Does not fire on_action for advisor being fired.

remove_alliance.doc: Ends the alliance with the specified country.

remove_building.doc: Removes the defined building from the current province scope. Buildings are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt.

remove_cardinal.doc: Removes a Cardinal from the current province scope, for the current owner.

remove_casus_belli.doc: Removes a casus belli held against the defined scope for the current scope. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt

remove_center_of_revolution.doc: Removes the Center of Revolution from a province

remove_church_aspect.doc: Removes the defined aspect from the current scope. Church Aspects are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/church_aspects/00_church_aspects.txt. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_church_power and the aspect set in aspects. Does not work with Blessings.

remove_claim.doc: In province scope, the defined scope loses their claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their claim on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

In province scope, the defined scope loses their claim on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their claim on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

remove_consort.doc: Removes the current consort for the current scope.

remove_core.doc: In province scope, the defined scope loses their core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their core on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

In province scope, the defined scope loses their core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their core on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

remove_country.doc: Removes scoped country from existence, all provinces become uncolonized, all subjects independent, and all units deleted

remove_country_modifier.doc: Removes an already assigned country modifier from the current scope.

remove_defender_of_the_faith.doc: Removes the Defender of the Faith from the current country.

remove_development_from_building.doc: Used only in the Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt file.

remove_enacted_issue.doc: Removes an enacted issue, allowing a new debate to start

remove_estate_privilege.doc: Removes the specified estate privilege from the country.

remove_faction.doc: Removes a faction from the current scope. Factions are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/factions/.

remove_fow.doc: Removes the fog of war in the current scope for the previous scope for a given number of months.

remove_government_reform.doc: If Dharma is active, removes a government reform. If this reform was not in the highest achieved reform tier, the country can pick a new reform for free. No effect if Dharma isn't active.

remove_guarantee.doc: Forces current scope to remove guarantee over specified country

remove_heir.doc: Removes the heir of the current scope. Does not display the heir death message.

remove_heir_personality.doc: Removes the defined personality from the current heir. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

remove_historical_friend.doc: Removes the historical friendship between the defined scope and the current scope.

remove_historical_rival.doc: Removes the historical rivalry between the defined scope and the current scope.

remove_idea.doc: Removes an idea for the current scope. Ideas are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ideas/*.txt.

remove_idea_group.doc: Removes an idea group for the current scope. Idea groups are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ideas/*.txt.

remove_latent_trade_goods.doc: Removes a latent trade good from the province.

remove_loot.doc: Removes loot from the current province scope and grants it to the defined country scope. The who parameter accepts enemy, which distributes the loot to all current enemies of the province owner.

remove_named_unrest.doc: Adds unrest to a province with a specified name

remove_opinion.doc: Removes an opinion modifier for the current scope held against the defined scope. Opinion modifiers are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt

remove_power_projection.doc: Removes an active power projection, if amount is not defined remove it fully

remove_province_modifier.doc: Removes an already assigned province modifier from the current province scope.

remove_province_triggered_modifier.doc: Removes a province triggered modifier from the current province scope.

remove_queen_personality.doc: Removes the defined personality to the current consort. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

remove_reform_center.doc: Removes the Center of Reformation for the defined religion in the current province scope.

remove_religious_reforms.doc: Removes taken religious reforms from the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using religious_reforms.

remove_rival.doc: Removes the defined scope as a rival of the current scope.

remove_ruler_personality.doc: Removes the defined personality to the current ruler. Ruler personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ruler_personalities/00_core.txt

remove_territorial_core.doc: In province scope, the defined scope loses their territorial core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their territorial core on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

In province scope, the defined scope loses their territorial core on the current province scope. In country scope, the current scope loses their territorial core on the defined province scope. Works for both types of claims.

remove_trade_modifier.doc: Removes a trade modifier for the defined country scope in the current tradenode province scope.

rename_capital.doc: Changes the capital name of the current province scope to the defined name. The capital name is the second name that appears under the province name within the province window.

reset_golden_age.doc: Resets Golden Age, allowing it to be fired again if fired before

restore_country_color.doc: Changes country color to country in scope or a RGB defined color, or yes to restore it

restore_country_name.doc: Restores the country name to its original if it has been changed via override_country_name

reverse_add_aggressive_expansion.doc: Adds or Subtracts X amount of aggressive expansion opinion modifier of the country in WHO against the scoped country

reverse_add_casus_belli.doc: Adds a casus belli against the current scope for the defined scope. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt

reverse_add_opinion.doc: Adds an opinion modifier for the defined scope held against the current scope. Opinion modifiers are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt

reverse_remove_casus_belli.doc: Removes a casus belli held by the defined scope against the current scope. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt

reverse_remove_opinion.doc: Removes an opinion modifier for the defined scope held against the current scope. Opinion modifiers are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/opinion_modifiers/*.txt

revoke_reform.doc: Removes an Imperial Reform. Imperial Reforms are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/imperial_reforms/00_hre.txt.

revolutionary_guard_artillery.doc: Spawns a revolutionary artillery unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected artillery unit.

revolutionary_guard_cavalry.doc: Spawns a revolutionary cavalry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected cavalry unit.

revolutionary_guard_infantry.doc: Spawns a revolutionary infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

round_variable.doc: Added in 1.37. Rounds a variable in place; `value` picks the mode.

samurai_infantry.doc: Spawns a samurai infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

save_event_target_as.doc: Saves the current scope as a key to be used in further effects/triggers and in localisations. Is cleared once execution ends (i.e. end of event and any events subsequently triggered by this event). Use event_target:<key> to access the scope.

save_global_event_target_as.doc: Saves the current scope as a key to be used in further effects/triggers and in localisations. Is NOT cleared once execution ends, but rather is kept until cleared with clear_global_event_target. Use event_target:<key> to access the scope.

send_missionary.doc: Starts religious conversion in the current province scope, for the current owner.

set_ai_attitude.doc: Makes the current scope (if AI) have the defined attitude against the defined scope. AI attitudes are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ai_attitudes/00_ai_attitudes.txt.

set_ai_personality.doc: Makes the current scope (if AI) the defined personality. AI personalities are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/ai_personalities/00_ai_personalities.txt.

set_allow_female_emperor.doc: Allows or disallows female rulers to become emperor.

set_army_professionalism.doc: Sets the country army professionalism to the given value.

set_base_manpower.doc: Sets base manpower of the current province scope.

set_base_production.doc: Sets base production of the current province scope.

set_base_tax.doc: Sets base tax of the current province scope.

set_capital.doc: Changes the capital of the scoped country to the selected province ID.

set_consort.doc: Makes an exiled consort the consort of the current scope.

set_consort_culture.doc: Changes the consort culture of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_consort_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | scope<province> | ref<province_id> | enum<country_tags>

set_consort_flag.doc: Defines a ruler flag for the current scope's consort. Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets via e.g. @root, if the consort becomes ruler then the consort flag becomes ruler flag

set_consort_religion.doc: Changes the consort religion of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_consort_religion.value: ref<religion> | enum<religion_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

set_country_flag.doc: A unique string to identify the country flag with. Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets: set_country_flag = my_flag@ROOT

set_defender_of_the_faith.doc: Sets the country as defender of the faith, overriding the existing defender if it exists.

set_dynasty.doc: Sets the dynasty of the current scope's ruler.

set_emperor.doc: Sets the current country scope emperor if <yes>, or removes the current emperor regardless of scope if <no>. It does not produce any popups.

set_emperor_of_china.doc: Sets the current Emperor of China.

set_estate_privilege.doc: Adds the specified estate privilege to the country.

set_government_and_rank.doc: Changes the current scope's government and rank at the same time. Governments are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/governments/*.txt. Will respect that governments have fixed ranks and the maximum ranks for subject types.

set_government_power.doc: Set the pool size of one of the power pools within a government mechanic.

set_government_rank.doc: Changes the government rank of the current scope. Default range is 1 to 3.

set_government_rank_force.doc: Changes the government rank of the current scope. Default range is 1 to 3.

set_heir.doc: Makes an exiled heir the heir of the current scope.

set_heir_culture.doc: Changes the heir culture of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_heir_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | ref<province_id> | scope<province> | enum<country_tags>

set_heir_flag.doc: Defines an heir flag for the current scope's heir. Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets via e.g. @root, if a heir becomes ruler then the heir flag will become a ruler flag.

set_heir_religion.doc: Changes the heir religion of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_heir_religion.value: ref<religion> | enum<religion_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

set_hre_heretic_religion.doc: Makes the defined religion the heretic religion of the HRE.

set_hre_religion.doc: Makes the defined religion the official religion of the HRE.

set_hre_religion_locked.doc: Locks the official and heretic religion assignments, ending the Religious Leagues.

set_hre_religion_treaty.doc: Ends the Religious Leagues with no set religions.

set_imperial_incident.doc: Starts a given imperial incident, or ends it if <none> is used. Do not attempt to start an incident without checking that there isn't already one active.

set_in_empire.doc: In country scope, places the current scope and all owned provinces (if valid) in the empire. In province scope, places the current province scope in the Holy Roman Empire.

set_incident_variable_value.doc: Sets the value of an Incident for the current scope. Incidents are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/isolationism/*.txt

set_isolationism.doc: Sets Isolationism to the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_isolationism.

set_karma.doc: Sets the Karma value for the current scope. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using uses_karma.

set_legacy_government.doc: Switches to the given government type.  No effect if Dharma is active.

set_local_autonomy.doc: Sets local autonomy to the current province scope.

set_mandate.doc: Sets the mandate value for the current scope. No effect if not the Emperor of China.

set_meritocracy.doc: Sets the current meritocracy for the current scope. No effect if not a government using has_meritocracy.

set_naval_doctrine.doc: Sets the naval doctrine of the country, ignores the can_select restrictions of the naval doctrine

set_papacy_active.doc: Enables or disables the papacy mechanic globally.

set_papal_controller.doc: Sets the defined country scope as the Papal Controller

set_primitive.doc: Primitive status for the current scope. Primitive status controls whether a country has ships and if they can see Primitive-only mechanics, such as Religious Reforms.

set_province_flag.doc: Defines a province flag for the current province scope. Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets with @scope.

set_religion_papacy_active.doc: Enables or disables the Papacy mechanic for the given religion.

set_religious_school.doc: Changes the current scope's religious school. Religious Schools are found in common/religions/00_religions.txt.

set_revolution_in_province.doc: Adds or removes the Revolution to/from the province.

set_revolution_target.doc: Makes the defined scope the new revolutionary target. Use --- to remove the target and not re-assign.

set_ruler.doc: Makes an exiled ruler the ruler of the current scope.

set_ruler_culture.doc: Changes the ruler culture of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_ruler_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | ref<province_id> | scope<province>

set_ruler_flag.doc: Defines a ruler flag for the current scope's ruler. Flags can be appended with scopes or event targets via e.g. @root

set_ruler_religion.doc: Changes the ruler religion of the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt. Can utilise Event Scope Values.
set_ruler_religion.value: ref<religion> | enum<religion_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

set_saved_name.doc: Saves a name to an unique key for usage in other effects. Usable with define_admiral, define_explorer, define_conquistador, define_general, define_ruler, define_consort, define_heir, define_advisor and spawn_rebels. Note: Does not work with country tags as scope, also type = simple does not work with spawn_rebels.

set_school_opinion.doc: Changes the current scope's school opinion towards the defined scope's school. -1 for negative, 0 for netural and 1 for positive.

set_seat_in_parliament.doc: Adds or removes the current province scope to/from Parliament. No effect if the owner of the province does not have a government using has_parliament.

set_state_edict.doc: Enacts the specified edict in the state of the current province scope. Will cause a crash if the province scope is not in a state; it must be used in combination with the is_state = yes trigger.

settle_province.doc: Settles a tribal province belonging to the owner of the ROOT province scope

show_ambient_object.doc: Displays a hidden ambient object from the map/ambient_objects.txt file.

spawn_center_of_revolution.doc: Sets a province as the Center of Revolution

spawn_large_scaled_rebels.doc: Spawns the defined rebels in the current province scope. Rebel types found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/rebel_types/*.txt. Note: the size of revolts follows this formula: number of regiments = round[(4 + 0.3 * total development) * (1 + 0.03 * technology level) * rebellion size]

spawn_rebels.doc: Spawns the defined rebels in the current province scope. Rebel types found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/rebel_types/*.txt. Note: the size of revolts follows this formula: number of regiments = round[(4 + 0.3 * total development) * (1 + 0.03 * technology level) * rebellion size]

spawn_small_scaled_rebels.doc: Spawns the defined rebels in the current province scope. Rebel types found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/rebel_types/*.txt. Note: the size of revolts follows this formula: number of regiments = round[(4 + 0.3 * total development) * (1 + 0.03 * technology level) * rebellion size]

sqrt_variable.doc: Replaces a variable with its square root.

start_debate.doc: Starts debate on issue, cancelling any previous active debate with no loss of prestige

start_estate_agenda.doc: Starts an agenda for a certain or a random estate

steer_trade.doc: Forces scoped country to steer trade to defined country

streltsy_infantry.doc: Spawns a streltsy infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

support_independence_of.doc: Makes the current country support the independence of the specified country

swap_free_idea_group.doc: Re-evaluates the current scope's national idea set assignment, if they match a different set, they will switch to it. Used after tag changes to change National Idea sets.

swap_non_generic_missions.doc: Reloads the mission tree. Useful for flag-based mission trees.

switch_tag.doc: Switches the player view to <scope> tag. Original country becomes controlled by AI.

tercio_infantry.doc: Spawns a tercio infantry unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the currently selected infantry unit.

this.doc: Switches the block's scope to the current scope; block contents are effects.

transfer_papal_controller.doc: Transfer the current Papal controller to the given country

transport.doc: Spawns a transport ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current transport ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.

Spawns a transport ship unit for the current country scope in the defined province scope, or vice versa. Uses the current scope's current transport ship unit. Requires the province scope to have a port.

trigger_switch.doc: The trigger_switch scope is used in conjuction with triggers that return discrete values. You list each trigger value you wish to act on, and add the effects within.

undiscover_country.doc: The defined scope loses vision of the current province scope. Best used within areas, regions, etc to remove vision.

undiscover_province.doc: The current country scope loses vision of the defined province scope. Best used with areas, regions, etc to add vision.

unfreeze_government_power.doc: Freezes the pool size of one of the power pools within a government mechanic so it cannot changed until unfrozen.

unlock_cult.doc: Adds the defined cult to the current scope. Cults can be found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/fetishist_cults/*.txt. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using fetishist_cult.

update_sprite_pack.doc: Updates the unit sprites for the scoped country

use_monarch_as_leader.doc: Turns the monarch into a leader

vassalize.doc: Makes the defined scope a vassal subject of the current scope. Uses the vassal subject type. Exact same effect as create_vassal.

voc_indiamen_light.doc: Spawns a voc indiamen light ship unit in the current province scope for the defined country scope. Uses the defined scope's current light ship unit. Requires the current province scope to have a port.

while.doc: The while scope is used to repeat execution of a set of effects whilst a set of trigger values remain true. Notes: A while scope loop will continue for 100,000 loops before it terminates if the trigger values never become false. It will also produce no tooltip.

white_peace.doc: Forces the defined scope into a white peace truce with the current scope.

add_absolutism.doc: Adds absolutism to the current scope. Can also subtract. No effect if Absolutism isn't active.

add_accepted_culture.doc: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope. Cultures are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cultures/*.txt.
add_accepted_culture.value: ref<culture> | enum<culture_new_variables> | scope<country> | enum<country_tags> | scope<province> | ref<province_id>

add_accepted_culture_or_dip_power.doc: Adds a new accepted culture to the current scope. In contrast to the standalone effect, this variant requires the culture to be specified by name. The dip reward will only be granted if the country has zero remaining promoted culture slots.

add_active_policy.doc: Adds a policy for the current scope. Policies are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/policies/*.txt. Won't work if the policy triggers are not met by the country, or there are no free policy slots.

add_adm_power.doc: Adds Administrative power to the current scope.

add_adm_tech.doc: Adds ADM technologies to the current scope. You cannot remove technologies.

add_aggressive_expansion.doc: Adds or Subtracts X amount of aggressive expansion opinion modifier of the scoped country against the country in WHO

add_army_professionalism.doc: Adds Army Professionalism to the current scope. 1 is equal to 100 professionalism.

add_army_tradition.doc: Adds Army Tradition to the current scope.

add_authority.doc: Adds authority to the current scope. Used in Religious Reforms that use authority. No effect if the country does not hold a religion using authority.

add_base_manpower.doc: Adds base manpower to the current province scope.

add_base_production.doc: Adds base production to the current province scope.

add_base_tax.doc: Adds base tax to the current province scope.

add_building.doc: Adds the defined building to the current province scope. Buildings are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/buildings/*.txt.

add_building_construction.doc: Starts building construction in the current province scope.

add_cardinal.doc: Adds a Cardinal to the current province scope, for the current owner.

add_casus_belli.doc: Adds a casus belli for the current scope against the defined scope. Casus belli are found in /Europa Universalis IV/common/cb_types/*.txt
